title: Termwise injective K-injective complexes are fibrant in the flat model
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and $R$ a sheaf of commutative rings on it, with abelian category $\operatorname{Mod}(R)$ of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and cochain complexes as in [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. Let $I$ be a K-injective complex of $R$-modules [def-pur-kinjective-complex] each of whose terms $I^r$ is an injective object of $\operatorname{Mod}(R)$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Let $i:A\to B$ be a morphism of complexes of $R$-modules which is a monomorphism in every degree and whose cokernel complex is acyclic [def-pc-acyclic-complex-modules]. Then every morphism of complexes $f:A\to I$ extends to a morphism of complexes $g:B\to I$ with $g\circ i=f$. Consequently $I$ is a fibrant object of the flat model structure on complexes of $R$-modules of [lem-coef-sheaf-flat-model], i.e. $I\to0$ has the right lifting property against its trivial cofibrations.
